# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-6

## Summary

Thorough review of the save-schema versioning and migration scaffolding (tanksim-6e5.1.2.3). The implementation is well-structured and correct. Key strengths: (1) The migration registry pattern with compile-time assert (`MIGRATIONS.len() == SCHEMA_VERSION - MIN_SUPPORTED_SCHEMA`) guarantees migration chain integrity at compile time. (2) Two real migrations demonstrate the pattern — v2→v3 does a non-trivial rescaling of dissolved chemistry totals from gross to net water volume with comprehensive input validation, and v3→v4 is a no-op showing how serde defaults can be leveraged. (3) Three distinct error variants (SchemaVersionTooNew, SchemaVersionTooOld, SchemaMigration) provide clear, actionable error messages. (4) The migration contract is well-documented in doc comments with a 5-step checklist for adding new migrations. (5) 18 tests cover roundtrip save/load, deterministic resume, full migration chain (v2→current), malformed input rejection (missing fields, negative values, exceeded geometry bounds), future/old version rejection, carbonate cache repair, and stability tracker reseeding. (6) The API layer in tank_api properly integrates via `SaveFile::from_value()` and maps errors to appropriate HTTP status codes (400 for version issues, 500 for invariant violations). (7) Post-migration, the load path correctly normalizes carbonate state and reconciles the stability tracker before `into_engine()` runs invariant enforcement. All acceptance criteria are met: tests demonstrate migration application, unknown versions produce clear errors, and the migration path is documented for later contributors.

## Amendments

None.
